set.body: From S4.5e (p0-s45e). Nothing in StudyBackend serves fixation onset or duration, so the timeline builder runs on test values only. Add a view, e.g. trialFixations(dataset, trial): F[Either[BackendError, TrialTimeline]], with StudioRef.Fixation, onset ms, duration ms and placement. FakeStudyBackend serves it from fixtures/studio-golden/fixations.csv, which means extending project/StudioFixture GoldenInventory. Needed by S6.3.
set.title: StudyBackend view serving trial fixation timing (onset, duration) per fixation ref
